variants.label: Bar Harbor base · 7 nights
variants.notes: Fly Pittsburgh to Portland, rent one car and sleep all seven nights in Bar Harbor. Ocean Path, Jordan Pond, Cadillac Mountain, a weather-reset day and the quiet side fit without moving hotels.

sourceLocators.internal-itinerary: short-acadia/main.json Jun 12–19 route, seven Bar Harbor hotel nights, four PTO days and itemized $6,700–$10,200 total

alternateNotes: Seven nights is already the short-trip ceiling. A second base or Schoodic overnight adds packing and driving without improving this ease-first plan.
